fact: A campaign with the Centre de Linguistique Appliquée de Dakar produced 210 hours of Wolof, Pulaar and Sérère voice data and two models, M-Kiriku ASR and M-Kiriku TTS, released open source with datasets and benchmarks on AI Hub Sénégal's Hugging Face.
title: IA et langues nationales : l'État veut transformer les prototypes du Kiriku
